The Shop

Millions of years,
one small storefront.

From fossils older than history itself, crystal and mineral specimens found all around the world, meteorites from the great beyond, and unique historical artifacts, we have a little something for everyone!

Stop in, ask questions, and stay curious 🦖

What's Inside

What we Offer:

Fossils

Ancient life turned to stone — teeth, bone, shell, and creatures that outlasted their eras.

Minerals

Crystals and cut stone pulled from deep in the earth's crust, raw and polished alike.

Artifacts

Worn, weathered objects with real history in them. Every one has a story we're happy to tell.

Meteorites

Specimens from beyond our planet, each telling a story of the cosmos.
